response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM circuit_counts), excesses AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS excess_rank FROM excesses WHERE excess > 0) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM ranked WHERE excess_rank <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId;
